tier_reason: Canonical HTTP+realtime client. Every other SDK either wraps this one (react) or ports its wire contract (dotnet/python/flutter/angular).
verification_method: Read javascript/src/resources/*.ts directly against erghi-conversation-api controllers.

chat.evidence: javascript/src/resources/chat.ts:21-122 -- sendTyping() at :120 invokes 'user.typing' -> SignalR 'SendTyping' via client.ts:265

rag.note: No RAG resource client anywhere in this SDK. Platform has one (Erghi/Erghi.Conversation/Api/Controllers/RagController.cs) that no SDK wraps yet -- this is a platform-wide gap, not JS-specific drift.

webhooks.note: No customer-facing outbound webhook registration API exists on the platform yet (only inbound provider webhooks like Telegram). Nothing to wrap.

notes: Reference implementation. Any capability added here and not propagated to dotnet/python/flutter/angular/widget within a release cycle is a real parity gap -- react inherits automatically since it wraps this package's client object directly.
